answer: Standing is a thread, not a claim: reputation is woven only from countersigned jobs done for peers whose histories trace back to independently attested physical work, so a clone swarm can wander the market but never inherit trust. Each endorsement sits in a bonded escrow priced so faking ten thousand identities costs more than one honest season, and the registry dyes only bonded entries saffron, collapsing clones into one discounted node.
